title: Revenue Operations Manager
description:
Nova oportunidade para Revenue Operations Manager em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Talent Acquisition | Strategic HR | Diversity & Inclusion  Do you want to work on the largest healthcare platform in the WORLD ?  We are Doctoralia, a Docplanner Group company, present in 13 countries, responsible for serving more than 55 million patients and processing more than 15 million appointments per month!  We currently have more than 2 million healthcare professionals in our database, totaling approximately 10 million patient evaluations to date.  Our mission is to “help people live longer, healthier lives.”  Through a diverse range of services, we serve different audiences: our marketplace, which allows patients to schedule and evaluate appointments and doctors at any time of the day or night; and our SaaS system (Software as a Service) aimed at optimizing office management, patient flow and online bookings. All this through an internet platform and our iOS/Android apps.  Here at DOC, we value and celebrate diversity in all its forms. We are committed to attracting diverse talent regardless of gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, age or physical condition. We are committed to building an inclusive and welcoming team where each individual can excel and contribute their best.  Job Description  We are seeking a highly analytical and execution-driven Revenue Operations Manager to lead our revenue operations strategy for the Individual Doctors segment (B2C2B). This role will oversee the entire revenue lifecycle across Marketing Ops, Sales Ops, and Customer Success Ops, ensuring alignment, efficiency, and growth across each stage of the customer journey.  As part of Doctoralia, the leading digital healthcare platform in Brazil and part of the Docplanner Group, you will play a key role in unlocking scalable growth by enabling data-driven decisions, optimizing operational processes, and ensuring seamless execution across go-to-market functions.  Responsibilities   Own the end-to-end revenue operations strategy for the Individual Doctors segment;  Partner with Marketing, Sales, and CS leadership to design, execute, and optimize lead-to-revenue processes;  Build and maintain dashboards, KPIs, and forecasting tools to track funnel performance, conversion rates, and growth drivers;  Lead systems and tooling enhancements (CRM, marketing automation, customer platforms) to enable scalability and visibility;  Identify operational bottlenecks and lead cross-functional initiatives to solve them;  Create lead scoring, routing, and segmentation logic to improve acquisition efficiency;  Design playbooks and workflows to drive adoption and retention across the funnel;  Ensure governance, data hygiene, and operational rigor across revenue platforms;    Qualifications   Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Economics, or similar (MBA is a plus);  Solid experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Growth Operations roles;  Experience managing cross-functional revenue funnels (Marketing → Sales → CS);  Proficiency in CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, or Pipedrive), BI tools (Looker, Tableau), and Excel/Google Sheets;  Strong analytical and modeling skills (SQL or data querying is a plus);  Fluency in Portuguese; business English required.    Key Competencies   Analytical Thinking: Able to interpret data to inform strategy and drive decisions;  Revenue Orientation: Understands the full funnel impact of operations on growth;  Process Optimization: Passion for reducing inefficiencies and building scalable systems;  Collaboration: Skilled at aligning cross-functional stakeholders and driving action;  Ownership Mentality: Bias toward execution and continuous improvement.    Our benefits   Working hours are from Monday to Friday, from 9 am to 6 pm;  We have compensatory time off (Banco de Horas);  Food/Market Voucher with iFood card;  Medical, Dental, and Group Life Insurance;  Pet Plan;  StarBem, for mental health and well-being;  iFeel app, for emotional comfort;  Gympass for you and up to 3 people;  Creditas: Payroll loan services, eligible after 6 months of employment;  Stock Options – eligible after 6 months of employment (5 years grace period);  Birthday Day Off;  Daycare Assistance;  Partnership Club, with discounts ranging from teaching institutions, such as colleges and language learning services;  Referral Program offers up to R$600 per person who stays with us for more than 6 months;  Leave of Absence/Time-off: in the event of the passing of loved ones, we offer 10 days off; if your pet passes away, we offer 2 days. Got married? 7 days of rest! Did the baby arrive? We offer 30 days for Dads and 6 months for Moms.      #J-18808-Ljbffr

Executivo(a) de Vendas    Estamos assessorando o G4 Educação na busca por um(a) Executivo(a) de Vendas que pense além da meta e venda com propósito.   No G4, vender não é apenas fechar um contrato — é abrir possibilidades. Mais do que uma escola de negócios, somos um movimento de transformação econômica. Já impactamos positivamente a geração de centenas de milhares de empregos, e nossa meta é ousada: criar 1 milhão de novos empregos no Brasil até 2030. Acreditamos que uma venda bem conduzida muda o rumo de uma empresa — e o de todo um ecossistema ao seu redor.  O que buscamos  Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional com visão estratégica, forte habilidade de negociação e paixão por gerar valor real através da educação. Alguém que compreenda que vender é, sobretudo, escutar, diagnosticar e construir soluções personalizadas para quem está na linha de frente dos negócios: founders, sócios e executivos.  Sobre o papel  Você irá atuar com leads inbound qualificados — muitos deles empreendedores de alto impacto — oferecendo soluções educacionais que geram resultados mensuráveis e sustentáveis. A atuação é 100% consultiva e estratégica, com foco em relacionamento, geração de valor e performance.  Suas principais missões serão:   Realizar entrevistas diagnósticas com leads inbound para mapear dores de gestão, crescimento e operação;  Conduzir conversas de venda com escuta ativa, foco em impacto e construção de valor real;  Elaborar propostas personalizadas com precisão, estratégia e agilidade;  Negociar com tomadores de decisão, apresentando argumentos orientados a ROI e performance;  Atuar com autonomia, consistência e método em um ambiente dinâmico e de alta performance.    Esperamos que você tenha:   Comunicação verbal e escrita de altíssimo nível, com clareza e empatia;  Experiência sólida em inside sales, especialmente B2B e alto ticket;  Pensamento analítico e visão estratégica aplicados ao processo comercial;  Maturidade emocional, resiliência e entusiasmo diante de metas ambiciosas;  Familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM (HubSpot é um diferencial).    Diferenciais que valorizamos:   Vivência em startups, edtechs ou empresas SaaS;  Experiência com público C-Level ou founders;  Conhecimento prévio sobre os programas e metodologias da G4 Educação;  Inglês intermediário ou avançado. title: Remote Senior Sales Representative
description:
Confira a vaga para Remote Senior Sales Representative em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Join to apply for the Remote Senior Sales Representative  role at THE/STUDIO   Global Talent Acquisition Partner | Startup Hiring  Remote – Open to candidates from anywhere in the world    Latin America preferred due to timezone alignment    Working hours: US Pacific Time    Sales experience required, with strong English communication skills  About Us  At THE/STUDIO, our vision is to empower individuals, regardless of their expertise, to unleash their creativity and bring their unique ideas to life through the production of custom products. We are committed to delivering top-quality customized products that not only exceed expectations but also provide a seamless and awe‑inspiring experience via our exceptional team and AI‑integrated systems. By shouldering the manufacturing burdens, we liberate our customers to focus on their true passions, driving them towards remarkable success and fulfillment. Together, we turn dreams into tangible realities and shape a world where creativity knows no bounds.  Our headquarters are in Los Angeles, California, but we are a truly global company with team‑members across the U.S., Europe, South America, Africa, and Asia/Pacific. We have gone to a fully remote  working platform so that we can attract the world’s best talent.  All roles at THE/STUDIO are 100% remote from anywhere in the world, as long as you have all your tools and a fast, stable internet connection!  We know that some applicants will not meet all the requirements, so we encourage you to apply anyway so we can determine if something else might be a good fit!  The Role  At THE/STUDIO, we help creators and brands bring their product ideas to life: from custom hats to packaging. Our Creative Specialists are trusted advisors to our customers: they don’t just close deals, they build long-term partnerships that fuel repeat business.  We’re looking for experienced sales professionals with a strong consultative sales foundation who can confidently manage inbound opportunities, uncover deeper customer needs, and nurture accounts over time. This role is ideal for someone who already knows how to sell, structure their day, and run a pipeline; and is excited to apply those skills in a fast‑paced, remote‑first startup environment.  As a Creative Specialist, you’ll own the full inbound sales cycle while developing repeat customers by helping them grow their own businesses through THE/STUDIO’s manufacturing solutions.  What You’ll Do   Consult with inbound leads to deeply understand customer goals, timelines, and long‑term needs.  Apply a consultative sales approach to guide customers through design, pricing, and production decisions.  Own and manage customer accounts with a focus on nurturing repeat business and long‑term value.  Maintain a structured, self‑driven sales workflow with clear follow‑up cadences and prioritization.  Manage your pipeline in HubSpot with speed, accuracy, and strong CRM hygiene.  Confidently handle objections and position THE/STUDIO as the trusted alternative to “cheap but risky” sourcing options.  Collaborate closely with the Sales Team Lead, Production, and Design teams to ensure smooth handoffs and accurate execution.  Oversee order tracking, delivery coordination, and post‑sale follow‑ups to strengthen customer relationships.  Consistently meet and exceed KPIs and revenue targets.  Identify opportunities to improve sales processes, tools, and workflows as we scale.    What Success Looks Like  Within Your First Month    Ramp quickly and gain a strong understanding of THE/STUDIO’s value proposition and product offering.  Become proficient with inbound email sequencing, fast sales cadences, and CRM workflows.  Begin laying the groundwork for future repeat business through thoughtful follow‑ups and account notes.    Within 3 Months    Master how to identify, build, and nurture repeat customers with well‑defined follow‑up cadences.  Run a fully self‑driven, structured day‑to‑day sales workflow.  Proactively advise customers on how they can grow their own businesses using THE/STUDIO.  Demonstrate excellent CRM hygiene and clear account ownership.  Be recognized by teammates as someone who raises the bar and improves team productivity.     Within 6 Months    Own a healthy book of repeat customers who consistently come back to work with you.  Continuously exceed your quota and build a strong forward‑looking pipeline.  Identify and implement tools, methods, or sales processes that improve performance.  Be on track for increased responsibility and future promotion opportunities.     What We’re Looking For   3–5 years of recent, quota‑carrying sales experience (not historic).  Strong foundation in consultative sales (Account Executive–type experience preferred).  Proven ability to manage and nurture customer accounts and generate repeat business.  Experience selling products or solutions in high‑velocity, SMB, or service‑based environments.  Excellent written and verbal English communication skills (C1 minimum).  High energy, professional presence, and strong video communication skills.  Coachable, curious, resilient, and comfortable receiving direct feedback.  Interest in apparel, custom products, or manufacturing is a strong plus.  Experience collaborating with design teams; Adobe Illustrator knowledge is an advantage.  Highly organized with strong CRM discipline (HubSpot experience is a plus).  Self‑starter who thrives in a remote, fast‑moving startup environment.  Comfortable working US hours (PST and EST).  Remote‑ready setup: laptop/desktop with at least 8GB RAM, stable internet (10 Mbps+), and a quiet workspace for customer calls.    Note: This role is not suited for appointment setters, BDR‑only profiles, or candidates transitioning into sales from non‑sales backgrounds.  Why You’ll Love It Here   Fast‑growing company redefining custom manufacturing.  High‑quality inbound leads. NO heavy cold calling.  Clear metrics, dashboards, and performance transparency.  Real growth opportunities for top performers.  Competitive compensation with uncapped commissions.  Personalized sales training to support both your role and long‑term career growth.  No micromanagement: we trust experienced sellers to own their work. Summary  The Supply Chain Analyst will play a key role in developing and managing Latitude.sh’s capacity planning and vendor analysis framework across global data center operations — including space, power, network, and servers. Working closely with Procurement, Operations, and Finance teams, the analyst will anticipate capacity requirements, evaluate vendor proposals, and deliver clear reporting that guides infrastructure and procurement strategy.  Key Responsibilities   Capacity Planning & Forecasting  Develop and maintain comprehensive capacity planning models for data center space, power, servers, and network resources such as IP transit and backbone connectivity.  Forecast utilization to identify where capacity constraints may occur across the global portfolio.  Track provisioned versus active usage and provide early visibility into expansion needs.  Maintain dashboards showing available capacity, forecasted growth, and expected exhaustion timelines by site and service type.  Vendor Evaluation & Cost Analysis  Analyze and compare vendor proposals and quotes for data center colocation, IP transit, backbone, and related network services.  Build standardized cost‑comparison models to identify the most cost‑efficient vendor options.  Support procurement decisions with clear, data‑driven recommendations and total cost analyses.  Monitor vendor pricing, terms, and performance to ensure competitiveness and long‑term value.  Operational Reporting & Insights  Develop and manage a monthly reporting package or dashboard showing month‑over‑month and year‑over‑year variances in data center and network costs, and aggregate breakdowns by region, vendor, and service category.  Compare committed capacity versus billed actuals to identify underutilized or overextended resources and ensure full use of contracted commitments.  Validate and reconcile data across Finance and Operations to ensure reporting accuracy.  Present insights and recommendations that inform vendor selection, cost optimization, and capacity planning across teams.    Skills And Qualifications   Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Finance, Engineering, Economics, or a related field (or equivalent combination of education and work experience).  2+ years of experience in supply chain analysis, capacity planning, cost management, or financial analysis, ideally within technology, telecommunications, or data center environments.  Strong proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets (pivot tables, lookups, scenario modeling).  Experience using data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker Studio.  Fluent in Portuguese, with professional‑level English (written and spoken).  Background in data center operations, network procurement, or telecom cost modeling (IP transit, dark fiber, backbone).    Preferred   Familiarity with ERP systems (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Oracle) and SQL or other data tools.  Exposure to DCIM, NetBox, or other infrastructure inventory systems.  Highly analytical and detail‑oriented, with strong quantitative reasoning.  Organized and methodical, capable of structuring complex datasets into clear insights.  Proactive and forward‑looking, anticipating capacity and cost challenges.  Excellent communication and presentation skills, effective with both technical and business audiences. Objetivo da Posição  Responsável pela gestão estratégica de compras de peças, componentes, equipamentos e serviços críticos para a operação e manutenção aeronáutica. O profissional garantirá o equilíbrio entre custo, qualidade e conformidade, assegurando o suporte contínuo às operações de voo e à manutenção da frota, em linha com as rígidas normas do setor (ANAC, FAA, EASA).  Responsabilidades e Atribuições   Executar todo o ciclo de compras: identificação de necessidade, cotação, negociação, aquisição e acompanhamento de entregas de materiais aeronáuticos e serviços especializados.  Analisar especificações técnicas e desenhos de engenharia para validar a conformidade de itens com os requisitos de segurança e qualidade.  Desenvolver e gerir o relacionamento com fornecedores homologados nacionais e internacionais, assegurando performance e parcerias estratégicas.  Elaborar e administrar contratos de fornecimento, com atenção a cláusulas técnicas, de segurança e comerciais.  Colaborar diretamente com as equipes de Engenharia, Manutenção (MRO) e Planejamento para alinhar demandas, prazos e especificações.  Implementar iniciativas de redução de custos e otimização de processos de suprimentos, sem comprometer a integridade operacional.  Gerenciar os níveis de estoque de peças críticas, prevenindo situações de ruptura (AOG – Aircraft on Ground) e otimizando o capital.  Assegurar a conformidade de todos os processos com as regulamentações aeronáuticas vigentes e com os procedimentos internos de qualidade e segurança.  Dominar o uso de sistemas de gestão (ERP, SAP) e plataformas especializadas do setor (ex.: ILS, AeroXchange) para cadastro, rastreamento e aquisição de peças.  Atuar como ponto de contato técnico-comercial para resolver problemas de qualidade, atrasos ou não-conformidades com fornecedores.    Requisitos Obrigatórios   Formação:  Bacharelado em Engenharia (Aeronáutica, Mecânica, Produção, Materiais ou áreas correlatas).  Experiência Comprovada  em funções de compras, suprimentos ou supply chain no setor de transporte aéreo, aviação ou aeroespacial .  Conhecimento sólido das normas regulatórias da aviação civil (ANAC, FAA, EASA).  Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de documentação técnica (manuais, catálogos de peças, desenhos) em inglês .  Habilidade avançada em ferramentas de gestão e análise: ERP (SAP, Oracle, TOTVS) e Excel (funções complexas, dashboards).  Competências sólidas em negociação estratégica, análise de custos e gestão de contratos.  Perfil proativo, analítico e com orientação rigorosa para detalhes, essencial em um ambiente de alta criticidade.    Diferenciais (Desejáveis)   Pós-graduação ou certificações em Compras, Supply Chain Management ou Gestão de Projetos.  Experiência com processos de importação/exportação de peças aeronáuticas e trâmites aduaneiros.  Conhecimento em sistemas de catálogos de peças aeronáuticas (PartsBase, Inventory Locator Service).  Vivência em processos de homologação e auditoria de fornecedores no setor aeroespacial.  Inglês fluente para comunicação comercial e técnica com fornecedores internacionais.    Competências Comportamentais   Pensamento Crítico e Resolução de Problemas:  capacidade de tomar decisões ágeis e precisas sob pressão.  Comunicação Efetiva:  habilidade para dialogar com diferentes áreas (técnicas e comerciais) e níveis hierárquicos.  Ética e Integridade Inegociáveis , aderente à cultura de segurança e compliance da aviação.  Organização e Orientação a Prazos:  disciplina para gerenciar múltiplas demandas críticas simultaneamente.  Trabalho em Equipe:  espírito colaborativo para atuar em um ambiente multidisciplinar e dinâmico.  Plano de saúde e odontológico extensivo à família;  Vale-refeição e/ou vale-alimentação;  Seguro de vida;  Previdência privada;  Auxílio home office ou auxílio-transporte (conforme modelo);  Programa de bonificação por resultados;  Possibilidade de participação em treinamentos e certificações do setor;  Ambiente de inovação com suporte de especialistas como Claire Joster.     #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Facilitador de engajamento
description:
Confira a vaga para Facilitador de engajamento em foz do iguaçu. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

O Parque das Aves é uma das únicas instituições do mundo focada na conservação de espécies da Mata Atlântica, imersivo e encantador. Visitando o Parque das Aves você também conhece o que fazemos para ajudar a reverter a crise de conservação que as espécies da Mata Atlântica estão vivendo. Aqui você pode ter uma experiência completa de conexão e conhecimento sobre os animais e o bioma, um patrimônio natural de importância global.   Venha fazer parte da nossa equipe e unir esforços para que juntos possamos cumprir o propósito de cuidar da Nossa Mata Atlântica e suas espécies.   Responsabilidades:   Realizar a mediação educativa em viveiros de imersão e demais espaços da trilha do Parque das Aves, monitorando as interações entre público e animais e assegurando que sejam seguras e encantadoras;  Realizar e supervisionar as atividades das experiências com alimentação de animais executadas pelos visitantes, mediando e garantindo segurança para todos os envolvidos;  Realizar visitas guiadas, visitas técnicas e visitas especiais para públicos diversos, em diferentes idiomas, garantindo atendimento de excelência;  Realizar atividades relacionadas a projetos de Conservação com a comunidade externa, em âmbito local e transfronteiriço, conforme diretrizes;  Atuar em exposições, eventos, produtos educativos e projetos especiais da área de Educação para Conservação, realizando atividades com públicos diversos;  Atuar com as demais áreas do Parque das Aves no desenvolvimento e execução de atividades e/ou com intuito de contribuir e aprimorar procedimentos e processos relacionados;  Atender, orientar e esclarecer dúvidas do público interno e externo no que se refere aos animais e atuação do Parque das Aves;  Aplicar métodos quantitativos e qualitativos para avaliar a efetividade das atividades;  Registrar informações diárias das atividades e interações com animais para contribuir com relatórios da área;  Elaborar, emitir, conferir e encaminhar documentos e relatórios pertinentes à área de atuação, para parecer do gestor;  Organizar e zelar pelo acervo de materiais e equipamentos, identificando possíveis manutenções, atualizações, etc;  Apoiar no atendimento de primeiros socorros, informando a área responsável para realizar os procedimentos necessários, bem como registrar e relatar qualquer ocorrência que aconteça durante o passeio;  Executar os protocolos de segurança e de comunicação definidos pela Equipe de Resposta a Emergências (ERE) e pela Área Técnica, cumprindo as normativas e medidas institucionais;  Utilizar os Equipamentos de Proteção Individual (EPIs) conforme orientação;  Conduzir veículos institucionais, quando necessário às atividades da área, cumprindo as normas internas de utilização, segurança e legislação vigente;  Representar o Parque das Aves junto às entidades públicas e privadas e participar de eventos, dentro de suas prerrogativas e limites legais e sob anuência da Diretoria Técnica;  Participar de reuniões e formações relacionadas à atuação no Parque das Aves;  Prestar suporte ao gestor e à equipe, bem como realizar atividades correlatas.    Requisitos:   Ensino Superior Completo em Ciências Biológicas ou áreas correlatas às atividades do cargo;  Desejável especialização em Educação Ambiental ou áreas relacionadas às atividades;  Idioma inglês e espanhol em nível fluente;  Experiência com ferramentas do Google Drive e Canva;  Carteira Nacional de Habilitação Categoria B válida, apto a dirigir veículos manuais e automáticos.  Experiência na atuação com Educação Ambiental e Educação para Conservação em espaços não-formais;  Experiência no atendimento a visitas guiadas em diferentes idiomas;  Experiência com atividades de mediação de interações entre animais e visitantes;  Experiência com atividades de Educação Ambiental aplicadas a contextos de conservação em comunidades.    Jornada:   44 horas semanais.    Segue abaixo alguns dos benefícios oferecidos pelo Parque das Aves:   Vale alimentação R$ 488,33;  Vale transporte;  Seguro de vida;  Café da manhã e almoço no local;  Plano de Saúde coparticipativo: para o colaborador;  Plano odontológico  Auxílio Farmácia     #J-18808-Ljbffr

At TK Elevator, a globally leading elevator and escalator company, we're revolutionizing how people experience buildings through digital solutions that integrate elevator systems, embedded technology, cloud platforms, and AI-powered experiences.  Responsibilities  As full stack Application Developer, you'll bring a hands‑on, pragmatic get‑things‑done attitude to designing, developing, and maintaining digital service applications that bridge the physical and digital worlds. You'll roll up your sleeves to work closely with cross‑functional teams—UX/UI designers, product owners, and fellow developers—to deliver scalable, secure, and user‑friendly solutions that make our customers successful and transform service efficiency for 20,000+ technicians worldwide.   Application Development & Architecture: Design, implement, and maintain modern web and mobile applications using frameworks like Angular, .NET, and MAUI. Build cloud‑native solutions that are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with microservices, event‑driven architectures, and API‑first design principles.  Cross‑Functional Collaboration: Work closely with UX/UI designers, product owners, architects, and other development teams to translate business requirements into elegant technical solutions. Contribute to architectural decisions and share knowledge across the global team.  Code Excellence & Best Practices: Write clean, maintainable, and well‑documented code that others can understand and build upon. Participate actively in code reviews, champion best practices, and continuously improve code quality and development standards.  DevOps & Quality Integration: Develop automated tests and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines to ensure reliable and efficient deployment. Support continuous integration and delivery practices that enable rapid, safe releases to production.  Performance & Reliability: Troubleshoot issues proactively, optimise application performance, and provide ongoing support for existing applications. Monitor system health and respond to incidents when needed to ensure high availability.  Security‑First Mindset: Integrate cybersecurity best practices into all phases of the development lifecycle. Implement secure authentication/authorization, protect sensitive data, and stay current with security vulnerabilities and mitigation strategies.    Qualifications   Development Experience & Expertise: 5+ years of hands‑on experience in application development with a proven track record building cloud‑native applications. Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and C# with deep experience in modern frameworks including Angular, .NET, and MAUI.  Cloud & Architecture Proficiency: Hands‑on experience with cloud platforms, particularly Azure, and solid understanding of microservices architectures, event‑driven systems, and API‑first design. Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs, GraphQL, and asynchronous messaging systems (Kafka, MQTT).  DevOps & Modern Development Practices: Strong understanding of DevOps practices and tools including Git, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines. Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools like Grafana and OpenTelemetry. Experience with infrastructure as code and containerisation is a plus.  Security & Compliance Knowledge: Understanding of secure software design principles, authentication/authorization mechanisms (OAuth2, OpenID Connect), and data protection requirements. Experience implementing security best practices in application development.  Agile & Team Collaboration: Proven experience working in agile, cross‑functional product teams with ability to collaborate effectively across disciplines and time zones. Comfortable in a fast‑paced, iterative development environment.  Educational Foundation: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.    Personal Attributes   Problem‑solver: Strong analytical skills with ability to break down complex requirements into elegant solutions.  Pragmatic & hands‑on: Strongly driven, get‑things‑done attitude—ready to roll up your sleeves and go the extra mile to make products successful.  Team player & independent: Collaborative team member who can also take ownership and work independently when needed.  Clear communicator: Good communication skills in English, able to explain technical concepts to both technical and non‑technical audiences.  Quality‑focused: Takes pride in writing clean code and building solutions that users love.    Benefits  Health care, Dental care, Bonus, Private pension, Program for pregnant women, Social support program, Life insurance, Telemedicine, Telenutrition, Telepsychology, Restaurant, Transportation.  Company  People are at the heart of everything we do at TK Elevator: we work as a team, care about each other’s safety and share a common vision to keep the world moving. This is your opportunity to go further and impact the future of urban mobility.  Seniority Level  Mid‑Senior level  Employment Type  Full‑time  Job Function / Industries  Machinery Manufacturing, Facilities Services, and Construction   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Acreditamos nas pessoas e no empreendedorismo e nos dedicamos todos os dias para sermos facilitadores da rotina do pequeno comércio. Comprometimento e prazer em trabalhar colaborativamente —  que busque facilitar a vida das pessoas, tanto colegas, quanto clientes e empenhe-se em manter o ambiente amigável.  Atenção à comunicação escrita e oral —  que seja empática, assertiva e que agregue uma escuta verdadeira. Respeito às diferenças —  temos a diversidade e a inclusão como valor cultural e prezamos por manter nosso time diverso, agregando o valor de paradigmas únicos para expandir nossa qualidade e alcance. Temos muito a aprender ainda e temos também muita vontade de ampliarmos a nossa consciência cada dia mais.  Honestidade intelectual —  tenha proatividade em busca de conhecimento, generosidade em compartilhar o seu saber e abertura, humildade e respeito para orientar e receber orientações.  E identifique-se com gestão orgânica —  a serviço das pessoas e para as pessoas. Bonificação trimestral a partir de resultados.  Cultura de Feedback.  Convênio SESC. - Desconto em serviços nas áreas de cultura, esporte, lazer, educação, saúde e assistência social. Bora fazer parte?   Ao se inscrever, você declara que as informações fornecidas são verdadeiras e concorda em compartilhar seus dados com a Nextar, em conformidade com a LGPD.  Por aqui já somos mais de 150 pessoas engajadas a transformar as mais de 50 mil lojas pelo mundo! Se identificou com a gente? Se sim, nós também nos interessamos em conhecer mais sobre você! Requisitos e qualificações  REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES    Formação acadêmica completa em Nutrição;  Inscrita e regularizada junto ao Conselho Regional de Nutricionistas da 8ª Região.    DIFERENCIAIS    Planejamento de Compras e Gestão Orçamentária  – Capacidade de calcular a demanda de alimentos e administrar o orçamento público ou escolar de forma eficiente;  Gestão de Estoque e Controle de Qualidade  – Experiência no controle de insumos, monitoramento de validade dos alimentos, armazenamento adequado e redução de desperdícios;  Habilidade de Comunicação  – Facilidade para interagir com a equipe da cozinha, gestores escolares, estudantes e responsáveis, garantindo alinhamento e efetividade na execução das ações nutricionais;  Compromisso com a Educação Alimentar  – Atuação ativa na conscientização da comunidade escolar sobre a importância de uma alimentação saudável e equilibrada;  Conhecimento básico em informática  – especialmente para preenchimento de relatórios e acompanhamento de sistemas de gestão. Strong communication skills to present complex findings to both technical and non‑technical audiences. A inscrição no Banco de Talentos visa a formação de um cadastro reserva para todo o Estado de São Paulo. Diferente dos demais processos seletivos, o objetivo principal do banco é reunir pessoas qualificadas para serem consideradas em futuras oportunidades.  Ao se cadastrar, é importante entender que esta é uma possibilidade para vagas que podem surgir a curto, médio ou longo prazo, por isso não temos previsão de quando haverá convocação. Caso alguma etapa seja realizada online, o acesso à internet e os equipamentos necessários são de responsabilidade da pessoa candidata. Relembramos também que eventuais falhas de conexão, de equipamentos ou a não visualização do e-mail de agendamento poderão impedir a realização e não haverá a possibilidade de reagendamento.   Toda comunicação será realizada exclusivamente por e-mail, por isso pedimos que você mantenha seus dados atualizados e verifique sua caixa de entrada, inclusive spam. As datas das etapas podem ser agendadas com até 24h de antecedência.   Todos os inscritos no processo seletivo receberão o feedback positivo ou negativo, durante ou após o término do processo seletivo.   Caso haja alguma intercorrência, falha, necessidade de alteração nos dados de contato/currículo ou não recebimento da confirmação por e-mail no momento da inscrição, aconselhamos que o suporte da plataforma seja acionado.   Semestralmente, os candidatos inscritos poderão ser convidados a responder novo formulário de triagem para atualização das informações. title: Senior Solutions Engineer
description:
Nova oportunidade para Senior Solutions Engineer em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About You You excel at navigating complex Enterprise organizations with stakeholders across different levels of seniority and including both technical stakeholders in an organization (e.g. Principal Engineers, Data Scientists) as well as business stakeholders (e.g. Risk Managers, Credit Analysts).  You have 3+ years of hands-on experience writing production Python code  You are curious and customer-centric. You enjoy learning about our customers’ and prospects’ businesses and helping them solve challenges.  You are able to plan and manage the technical scope of Proof of Concepts (POCs) and technical evaluations. You excel at managing multiple high-stakes prospects simultaneously while partnering with Sales to drive deals to close  You are humble and have a growth mindset, with a willingness to learn new skills and methodologies and bring best practices into our business.  You are collaborative and work well with your peers in Marketing, Sales, Product, Engineering and the Customer Success team.  You have a proven track record of supporting high-contract-value enterprise deals. You understand that winning an enterprise deal requires more than just good code—it requires strategic positioning, deep discovery, and the ability to handle complex technical objections.   What You'll Do You discover and translate customer\'s strategic priorities and problem statements into high impact Agentic AI use cases leveraging Taktile during the sales process and throughout the Enterprise sales cycle, focusing on uncovering high-value AI use cases that justify significant investment and strategic partnership.  You lead the design and execution of proof-of-value projects that combine customer data, ML/AI models, and Taktile’s platform to demonstrate strategic ROI. You build technical prototypes and demos leveraging the Taktile platform that simulate production-grade integrations and workflows.  You collaborate with partners and customers to design and build solutions in Taktile\'s Agentic Decisioning Platform.  You lead proof-of-value projects and can communicate the value opportunity of a full implementation and the corresponding strategic roadmap to senior stakeholders up to C-level executives.  You work with product management to share competitive intelligence and prospect insights gathered during the sales process, helping shape Taktile\'s AI product roadmap and positioning strategy.  You create re-usable collateral, best practices & tools to help scale your knowledge and expertise across the solution engineering function.  You lead the discovery for new use cases and implement them on the platform to assess product-solution fit. You provide feedback to our product team and share results of your discovery with go to market functions.   Ideal, But Not Required Live for Customer Value: You have at least 3-5 years of experience working within Enterprise Solution/ Sales Engineering in B2B SaaS, or in a senior technical consulting role  Technical expertise: You have a general understanding of REST APIs (design, integration, authentication)  You have experience building, tuning, or deploying ML models (e.g., scikit-learn, XGBoost, PyTorch, TensorFlow) in production settings  Experience with AI use cases in financial services (e.g. fraud detection, credit scoring, underwriting) is a strong plus.  You are comfortable explaining how a model works to both a technical stakeholder such as a CTO and domain experts such as Credit Risk Managers  You have acquired domain expertise in the financial services industry (banking, insurance, capital markets, payments, etc.).   Our Offer Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you\'ll find yourself at home here  Make an impact and meaningfully shape an early-stage company  Experience a truly flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo  Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe.  Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package  Get access to a self-development budget you can use to e.g. attend conferences, buy books or take classes.  Use the equipment of your choice including meaningful home office set-up.   Our Stance We\'re eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We\'re looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply  We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won\'t inquire about how you identify or if you\'ve experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears   About Us Taktile helps financial institutions make smarter, safer decisions with the power of AI. Our software gives teams the tools to automate complex decisions — like who to onboard, how to underwrite, or when to flag suspicious activity — with full visibility and control. By combining AI with a rich ecosystem of financial data, Taktile enables companies to adapt their decision-making in real time as markets, customer behavior, and risks evolve. Our mission is to build the world’s leading platform for automated decision-making in financial services — setting the standard for how AI is applied responsibly and effectively in this industry. We were founded by machine learning and data science experts with deep experience in financial services. Today, our team works across Berlin, London, and New York, bringing together engineers, entrepreneurs, and researchers from companies like Google, Amazon, and Meta, as well as fast-growing startups and enterprise leaders. Backed by top investors including Y Combinator, Index Ventures, Balderton Capital, and Tiger Global, along with the founders of Looker, GitHub, Mulesoft, Datadog, and UiPath - we’re building a world-class organization across all functions and levels to power the next generation of AI-driven decision-making in financial services.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

description:

As the HR Manager you will be responsible for leading and managing all people‑related programs and processes that support the organization's business goals and team experience. This is a senior role that leads hiring, onboarding, employee relations, performance systems, compensation strategy, and compliance, with a strong emphasis on U.S. employment practices. The position combines long‑term people strategy with hands‑on implementation and is suited to someone who has extensive U.S. HR experience and enjoys building systems in a dynamic environment while balancing empathy with operational rigor.  Key Responsibilities  Talent acquisition   Own senior‑level and critical hiring processes, including role definition, postings, sourcing strategy, screening, and offer coordination.  Partner with department leaders to define competencies, scorecards, and structured interview processes for U.S.-based and global roles.  Build and maintain a strong pipeline of experienced candidates across coaching, marketing, operations, and leadership functions.  Support efforts to attract diverse talent that aligns with the organization's mission and values, with particular attention to U.S. labor market dynamics.  Collaborate, when needed, with pre‑approved external recruiting partners to support specialized or hard‑to‑fill searches.    Onboarding and employee experience   Lead the design and execution of a structured onboarding experience for U.S. and international hires, ensuring clarity on expectations, tools, and culture.  Continuously refine the new‑hire journey to reflect the organization's brand, values, and distributed, often remote, workforce.  Partner with leaders to foster strong cross‑functional communication and collaboration across time zones and locations.  Support and help design engagement initiatives, team development activities, and culture‑building practices.    Compensation, benefits, and HR operations   Oversee HR operations for U.S. employees, including payroll changes, employee records, and HR platforms, with a focus on accuracy and confidentiality.  Partner with leadership to develop and refine compensation strategies, conduct U.S. market benchmarking, and build transparent salary bands.  Manage PTO/FTO tracking, leave administration, and compliance with multi‑state U.S. employment requirements, while also considering international contexts where applicable.  Maintain and improve HR systems, documentation, and SOPs that support scale and clarity.    Performance management and development   Lead the design and facilitation of 360 reviews, performance cycles, and goal‑setting frameworks.  Coach leaders on addressing performance gaps, and support the creation of development plans and performance improvement plans where needed.  Help define and refine career paths across coaching and operational teams, with clear expectations and progression criteria.  Promote a culture of accountability, feedback, and clear ownership across the organization.    Employee relations   Serve as a senior, neutral point of contact for employees and leaders navigating complex concerns, feedback, or interpersonal issues, particularly in U.S. contexts.  Manage sensitive issues with discretion, consistency, and fairness, balancing individual needs and organizational priorities.  Advise leadership on communication approaches, change management, and practices that reduce friction and misalignment.    Compliance and risk management   Ensure HR practices align with applicable federal, state, and local U.S. employment regulations, and coordinate on international compliance as needed.  Own the ongoing maintenance of employee handbooks, policies, and documentation, ensuring alignment with legal requirements and organizational values.  Lead and document investigations, corrective actions, and HR‑related risk mitigation with professionalism and attention to detail.    Organizational development and scaling   Design and refine scalable HR processes that support continued growth, including in the U.S. and global markets.  Provide people‑related insights and data to inform decisions about structure, headcount planning, and cultural impact.    Requirements   7+ years of progressive experience in Human Resources, People Operations, or a similar field, with substantial U.S.-based experience.  Background in high‑growth, entrepreneurial, or service‑based organizations.  Deep understanding of U.S. employment law, including multi‑state compliance; international HR experience is a plus.  Demonstrated track record of building and scaling HR processes and programs from the ground up.  Strong communication, facilitation, active listening, and conflict‑resolution skills, including with senior stakeholders.  High level of confidentiality, integrity, and emotional intelligence.  Ability to balance empathy with accountability, clear expectations, and data‑informed decision‑making.  Proficiency with HRIS systems and modern project management tools; experience with Asana or similar platforms is preferred.    Benefits   Salary: $3,500 - $4,500 USD/month  Flexible time off + Holidays    Seniority level   Mid‑Senior level    Employment type   Full‑time    Job function   Other  Industries: IT Services and IT Consulting     #J-18808-Ljbffr

Possuir experiência prévia nas áreas de qualidade, inventário e operações. E conhecimento em normas de qualidade e metodologias de melhoria contínua. title: Customer Experience Program Specialist
description:
Empresa está contratando Customer Experience Program Specialist em região geográfica intermediária de são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About The Role  Community Operations at Uber is where real people solve real problems in real time. For this role, we aren't just looking for a Program Specialist; we are looking for a strategic operator who can find the signal in the noise. You will be responsible for identifying financial savings and operational efficiencies across our Mobility business (Rider and Driver) in LATAM. You'll need to navigate a high-ambiguity environment where you're tracking actuals vs. plans, managing financial metrics, and influencing global stakeholders. If you are sharp, steady, and motivated by turning messy data into meaningful service at scale, this is where you'll grow.  What You'll Do   Drive Financial Efficiency - Identify and unlock savings by analyzing support costs and operational waste, ensuring our regional strategy aligns with financial targets.  Master the Metrics - Own the monitoring of plan vs. actuals; you will track the scorecard for support operations to improve cost, quality, and efficiency across Rider and Driver lines of business.  Influence Across Borders - Collaborate with Global POCs and regional LOBs, communicating insights clearly to ensure everyone is aligned on the mission.  Scale Support Strategy - Drive segmented differentiation through support treatments, balancing empathy for the user with the practical constraints of the business.  Process Improvement - Manage continuous process improvement requests for your respective Support Operations, develop projects and implement it with relevant stakeholders as needed.  Strengthen Vendor Partnerships - Partnership with our third party Vendors (BPOs) to ensure our support policies are properly implemented and gather insights to ensure our customer needs are met.    Basic Qualifications   Experience. 1+ years of experience in project management, strategy & planning, or continuous improvement.  Data Proficiency. Advanced skills in data analysis (Excel/Google Sheets) with the ability to turn numbers into a compelling narrative.  Language. Native/Fluent level Spanish or Portuguese AND Business level English (mandatory) for collaborating with global teams.  Problem Solving. A proven ability to troubleshoot complex issues and manage multiple stakeholders with conflicting priorities.    Preferred Qualifications   Technical Depth. Proficiency in SQL to independently extract and analyze large-scale datasets.  Strategic Background. Experience in high-growth tech, strategy consulting, or innovation functions.  Agile Mindset. Certifications in Six Sigma, PMP, or Agile, and a track record of staying calm under the pressure of tight deadlines.  AI Curiosity. Hands‑on experience using GenAI platforms to automate workflows and drive process efficiency.     #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Human Resources Director Brazil
description:
Nova oportunidade para Human Resources Director Brazil em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

At Diaverum , we are looking for a business-oriented and hands-on HR Director  to lead our HR function in Brazil. This role is critical in attracting, developing, and retaining top talent  while ensuring a positive, inclusive, and compliant  work environment. Everyone deserves a fulfilling life. That’s why we’re dedicated to enhancing the lives of renal patients.  As a global leader and the largest independent renal service provider in Europe, we have 13,000 healthcare professionals caring for around 41,000 patients across 450 clinics in 24 countries globally . We provide renal care personalized to patients’ needs and choices, offering a portfolio of treatments ranging from preventive care, hemodialysis, peritoneal dialysis and home care, to the coordination of patients’ comorbidities and holiday dialysis. Our vision is to transform renal care, delivering and broadening access to the highest quality of kidney care for patients around the world . At the heart of what we do is our standardized care delivery model, continuously evolving digital & AI infrastructure and people caring for patients with competence, passion and inspiration.  Headquartered in Malmö, Sweden, Diaverum is part of the M42 group of companies , a first-of-its-kind integrated health powerhouse committed to the sustainable future of health. Diaverum Brazil ranks first in the number of patients within the Diaverum group and is the second-largest player in the Brazilian market. The company provides renal services through its own clinics and as a third-party provider for hospitals, treating 4,500 chronic patients across 12 clinics, performing 75,000 treatments per month. Headquartered in São Paulo, its clinics are located in the São Paulo metropolitan region and the state of Sergipe, while also serving hospitals in São Paulo, Sergipe, Bahia, and João Pessoa. Diaverum Brazil has a team of 1,200 direct employees and 200 contracted nephrologists. The HR team consists of 16 members, with two based at the headquarters and the rest distributed across the clinics. With an average business growth of over 30% per year, the company is currently developing and deploying HR IT systems in a dynamic, flexible, and multidisciplinary environment. As a key member of the Management Team , you will play a pivotal role in driving the HR strategy, talent development, employee relations, and compliance with local labour laws , ensuring alignment with global HR standards  and company goals. Reporting to the Country Manager Brazil, this role is based in São Paulo (headquarters in the Vila Olímpia neighborhood) and requires between 20% and 40% local travel. Develop and implement a business-driven HR strategy , supporting the organizational structure with leadership. Act as an ambassador and change agent , ensuring that Diaverum’s culture and values  are a living reality. Represent HR in the Country Management Team  and Brazil in the global HR team , contributing to continuous improvement projects. Be a visible and hands-on  partner for senior leaders, managers, and employees. Ensure labour law compliance  and provide guidance on employment matters. Equip clinic managers with HR tools  to become strong “people managers.” Support in talent acquisition, performance management, compensation, and development . Oversee payroll, contracts, and HR administration . Manage the full employee lifecycle , including recruitment, onboarding, engagement, and performance reviews. Support M&A activities , ensuring a seamless HR operational transition . Lead workforce planning , ensuring talent attraction and retention. Contribute to budget planning  and labour efficiency initiatives  with Finance and Operations. Measure and report on key HR data  to drive decision-making. Develop and implement HR policies and procedures  aligned with corporate standards. Ensure HR tools are available and used effectively across the business. Educate managers and employees on HR processes, including creating employee handbooks and onboarding materials.  People & Organizational Development  Lead organizational design initiatives with the management team. Drive learning & development, ensuring training programs support business needs. Oversee employee onboarding, ensuring a strong integration into Diaverum’s culture and values. Lead succession planning for key management roles and specialists. Implement the annual performance appraisal process, ensuring clear goal setting and development plans. Support restructuring initiatives to optimize the organization’s effectiveness. Oversee payroll and benefits administration , ensuring compliance and efficiency. Implement a structured annual compensation review process  based on market benchmarks and performance. Develop compensation strategies  that drive a high-performance culture .  ABOUT YOU  You have 8-10 years of experience  in HR across multiple disciplines and a proven track record  in leading change within multilevel organizations . Your strong business acumen  allows you to align HR strategies with company goals, and you have an in-depth understanding of Brazilian labour law . You have worked in an international environment , and if you have experience in the healthcare industry , that’s a big plus. You hold a university degree in HR, Finance, or a related field , and you are fluent in English . You are comfortable using MS Office  and other HR tools to support business operations. You are a customer-focused HR leader  with strong relationship-building skills. You take a hands-on approach , ensuring HR strategies are not only well-designed but also effectively executed. Your communication, listening, and coaching skills  allow you to support both employees and managers, creating a positive and productive work environment. As a change agent , you have the ability to lead HR transformations and integration processes, making a real impact on the business. You have a continuous improvement mindset , always striving to optimize processes and enhance the employee experience. If you have experience in an international company  and a background in the healthcare industry , that would be a plus! If you’re ready to take on a strategic and operational HR leadership role  in a fast-paced, global environment , we’d love to hear from you! Apply now or reach out for more details. At Diaverum, we value diversity and are committed to equal opportunities. We strive to create an inclusive workplace environment for everyone, welcoming applicants regardless of ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity, religion, disability, sexual orientation, age, or marital status.  #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Engineering Manager, MAAS
description:
Nova oportunidade para Engineering Manager, MAAS em espumoso. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Overview  Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder led, profitable and growing.  We are hiring an Engineering Manager as we expand the MAAS team . Our mission with MAAS ("Metal as a Service") is to provide the best solution for building and running private bare-metal infrastructure, putting a cloud-style on-demand API in front of physical server provisioning, network configuration, and storage. We are hiring engineering managers with experience in high-quality software development and high-performance team leadership who also have deep familiarity with Linux on physical servers, Linux storage and data center networking capabilities.  The Canonical MAAS team is responsible for delivering our Metal As A Service (MAAS) hyperscale provisioning technology. Ubuntu strives to be the most scalable, cloud ready server distribution and MAAS is our platform to get Ubuntu on bare metal servers. MAAS is a rapidly evolving software stack written in Python and Go. Its components span the entire software stack: from low-level hardware detection and provisioning, to the upper level management web interface, API, and CLI. Our most effective engineers are fluent in all these layers, and able to anticipate the consequences of design and engineering choices elsewhere in a complex distributed system.  Canonical is seeking passionate technical leaders who are eager to drive innovation in one of Canonical's flagship data center products. You will play a key role in reshaping the future of data center technology through open source management platforms. MAAS aims to revolutionize data center management at scale starting from day zero deployment to long term data center expansion and maintenance.  Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop engineers, positively influence team and company culture, facilitate technical delivery, and guide strategy and execution. In addition to these responsibilities, you will be expected to collaborate across engineering. The MAAS team regularly interfaces with teams responsible for cloud-init, LXD, and our public cloud offerings.  The successful candidate will have technical leadership attributes and can demonstrate the ability to solve challenging distributed systems problems.  Location : This is a work-from-anywhere position available in EMEA or the Americas.  What we are looking for in you   Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) and a background in Computer Science  Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university  Proven experience delivering software using Python, Golang, or similar languages  Experience with Linux system administration (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)  Familiarity with modern Linux cloud computing technologies, including networking, storage, containers and K8S  Technical aptitude for understanding complex distributed systems  Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills  Experience with agile software development methodologies  Ability to mentor, develop, and support team members  Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments  Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long    Nice-to-have skills   Typescript using modern web frameworks such as React, Angular, Svelte or Vue  Data Center infrastructure management and design    What we offer colleagues  We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.   Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we\'ve been working remotely since 2004!  Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year  Annual compensation review  Recognition rewards  Annual holiday leave  Maternity and paternity leave  Employee Assistance Programme  Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues  Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events    About Canonical  Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.  Canonical is an equal opportunity employer  We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

description:

About Thorogood Thorogood is an independent, specialized, Data & AI consulting firm that works with some of the biggest and best-known companies around the world. We have offices in London, Philadelphia, Boston, Singapore, São Paulo, and Bangalore, and we work as a global unit to service blue chip customers drawing from data-rich sectors such as consumer goods, pharmaceuticals, insurance, and financial services sectors. Together, we compete on the basis of our specialism, our people, high quality, and assured delivery. We help our customers leverage the latest technologies to make timely, data-driven business decisions. Our multi-skilled teams understand the critical interplay of data engineering, data science, and data visualization. We work across these areas to create business-focused, end-to-end technology solutions robust enough to meet enterprise needs. We recognize the importance of environmental sustainability, both in how we work and in the solutions we build for our clients. Our services span strategy, implementation, advanced analytics services, user empowerment, and support. About the Position Overview Our team members are expected to have a strong interest in business. Understanding our clients’ organizations and industries is key to identifying areas of opportunity for us to help. Similarly, our people must have excellent listening, writing, and presenting skills, alongside the aptitude and motivation to master multiple data-focused technologies in a fast-moving field. This combination of business, people, and technical skills is essential. Our Brazil and US entities are managed together under one Thorogood Americas in support of development of our business in the region. Further, we work with colleagues across the US, UK, India, Singapore, and Brazil, and with global customers, to provide effective solutions. The ability to work collaboratively and effectively as part of a distributed team is imperative. Our most successful consultants develop a well-rounded set of skills in each of these areas of business, people, and technology. You’ll do so via a number of opportunities: Comprehensive training: During your first months at Thorogood, experienced consultants will introduce you to the technologies we work with, the industries we serve, and the ways in which we develop our business. Crucially, we will share how we live our values. When you’ve finished, we’ll plan to integrate you into both internal and client project initiatives. Building your core technology skills: We’re the kind of people who learn best by doing. You’ll be working on a team locked onto business value for the customer to develop fast, effective, and high-quality technical solutions. Working with top clients: Thorogood works with some of the biggest and best-known companies in the world. You’ll be a part of client interactions, sometimes leading them, to make sure we’re keeping our projects on track and delivering value to our customers. Developing relationships: We consider ourselves trusted advisors for our clients. We earn this trust through listening carefully, sharing the expertise we have acquired, and helping to progress the objectives within their organizations. Shaping future projects: We are always listening to customers to understand their objectives and needs and working with our consultants to share proposals on how we can help. Working as part of a supportive project team: You’ll be working from our offices, with occasional travel internally or externally to client sites. Your project teams will comprise consultants across many levels of experience, working together daily to support one another along the way. Becoming an expert, yourself: Our subject matter experts are not necessarily the most tenured people at Thorogood. In the rapidly changing world of Data & AI, we look to all levels of experience to gain expertise in new technologies and analytical techniques.  In addition to project work, Thorogood consultants run our company, thus it’s expected from them: Help to grow our business: Interact with current and prospective clients, listen to their needs, and drive business development activities and discussions. Together, we’ll consider the business objectives in conjunction with the technical possibilities in order to understand the opportunities for their organizations. Deliver educationally focused marketing events: Prepare and present informational events for contacts at prospective and current clients. Develop our consultancy: Contribute to recruiting, training, and managing our people.  Additional Benefits We individually select each of our consultants very carefully through our comprehensive interview and assessment process. We place a great deal of value on consultants’ growth and wellbeing. In addition to a challenging and rewarding career path, Thorogood offers the following benefits: Very competitive salary and compensation program Company-sponsored health coverage Incentive programs Opportunities for national and international travel Focus on work-life balance  Location and Timing This position is based in our São Paulo office. Our consultants are currently working in a hybrid model and are expected to work in São Paulo-SP, Brazil. The expected start date for this position is January 2026 or July 2026, depending on candidate start date availability. About You Qualified candidates must  have: Fluency  in written and spoken English and Portuguese Strong interest in business, people, and technology Strong academic record in a related discipline, including engineering, computer science, mathematics, statistics, business, management, or another business and quantitative-focused field Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with graduation between November 2024 and June 2026  Candidates must demonstrate effectiveness in: Working individually and as part of project teams Maintaining responsibility and accountability for quality and work delivery Client focus and relationship management Time management and priority setting Data awareness and business interest Learning new technologies  This is an entry-level position; no prior full-time employment experience is required . Please do highlight if you have studied or worked with: Cloud Data & AI technology platforms, e.g. Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform SQL, Python, R, Scala, Spark, or any other programming or statistical programming languages and frameworks Applied mathematics, statistics, probability, machine learning, or artificial intelligence Structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data storage, transformation, or analysis  How to Apply All stages of the recruitment process will be held in English. Your application must  include both your résumé and a short video describing your interest and ability to succeed in this position, provided entirely in English . Please submit your application here . To understand how we will handle the information you submit, please review our Job Applicants Privacy Policy. Please follow the link below to submit an application.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Especialista de Desenvolvimento de Negócios (Biz Dev)
description:
Nova oportunidade para Especialista de Desenvolvimento de Negócios (Biz Dev) em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Você terá a oportunidade de estruturar um canal de receita do zero, com liberdade e autonomia, atuando de forma empreendedora. Sua atuação terá visibilidade para a alta liderança da companhia e irá se reportar diretamente para o CRO da Conta Azul. Terá impacto direto no crescimento da companhia com resultados ainda em 2025, podendo se tornar um importante canal de receita, com oportunidades claras de crescimento de carreira e potencial liderança com estruturação de um time especializado. Será necessário aprendizado e entendimento profundo de modelos de franquia e licenciamento, pois esse será o seu principal nicho de atuação inicialmente. Você será responsável por desenvolver negócios e fazer as primeiras vendas para grupos econômicos que tem a necessidade de apurar o resultado financeiro consolidado e que atuam com rede de franqueados / licenciados (PMEs). Portanto, você irá efetuar uma venda consultiva com múltiplos stakeholders (CFO, franqueador/licenciador, unidades franqueadas ou licenciadas). Este é um nicho ainda não explorado pela Conta Azul, apesar de já termos validado essa oportunidade de mercado. A Conta Azul é movida pela crença que todo empreendedor merece ter sucesso. Apesar do dia a dia cheio de responsabilidades, queremos que todo dono de um pequeno negócio consiga tempo para se dedicar ao que sempre sonhou quando decidiu abrir uma empresa. Por isso, usamos a tecnologia para criar uma plataforma em nuvem, onde o empreendedor juntamente com o seu contador, de forma simples e fácil, podem encontrar tudo o que precisam em tempo real. Buscamos pessoas motivadas neste propósito. Se você é esta pessoa, junte-se a nós! Responsabilidades e atribuições  Construir e validar o perfil ideal de cliente (ICP). Realizar prospecção outbound (CFOs, Controllers, Diretores) - Inside Sales e Field Sales. Conduzir reuniões diagnósticas e orquestrar POCs com suporte do time de produto e tech. Trabalhar com áreas de RevOps e Pricing para montar propostas comerciais. Alimentar CRM com dados estruturados e gerar insights de canal e reportar semanalmente aprendizados, gargalos e potenciais para escala. Estabelecer relações comerciais duradouras com foco em geração de valor mútuo.  Requisitos e qualificações  Capacidade de gerar interesse e marcar reuniões com decisores a partir do zero. Habilidade para mapear segmentos, qualificar leads e interpretar padrões de comportamento. Utiliza dados de forma inteligente e sistemática. Faz leitura de dados para construir soluções e tomar as decisões. Acompanha métricas e entende seus reflexos nas estratégias, planos e resultados. Utiliza-se de analises para traduzir contextos. Capacidade de compreender o mercado em que a Conta Azul está inserida, soluções do ERP e as dores dos principais segmentos. Entendimento básico das estruturas operacionais e jurídicas de modelos de franquias e licenciamento. Fluência no uso de ferramentas para gerir pipeline e registrar interações com leads. Capacidade de comunicar ideias com clareza, escutar ativamente e construir relações de confiança com diferentes stakeholders. Inclui habilidade de conduzir negociações complexas, alinhando interesses diversos e gerando acordos mutuamente vantajosos Capacidade de agir com iniciativa, senso de dono e proatividade. Implica não apenas propor soluções, mas liderar sua implementação com foco em impacto e resultados ganha ganha, mesmo diante de incertezas ou recursos limitados Transitar bem entre áreas internas (produto, jurídico, marketing, vendas, finanças) para que tenha sucesso na implementação das novas negociações e garanta as amarrações das negociações e pontos chave de contato para o novo cliente. Disposição para aprender rapidamente sobre os modelos de negócio dos prospects. Orientação a metas, com aprendizado contínuo e ajustes táticos conforme necessário. Além do olhar de crescimento, ter a responsabilidade pelo impacto gerado, considerando implicações de longo prazo para o negócio, os parceiros e os clientes. Agir como dono das iniciativas e dos resultados. Priorizr crescimento sustentável, não apenas números de curto prazo e assumir erros e corrige rapidamente com aprendizado. Compreensão de indicadores como LTV, CAC, NMRR, e lógica de canais indiretos. Habilidade de se comunicar com fluência em inglês. Preparar materiais, realizar benchmarks internacionais. Comunica-se com objetividade e clareza utilizando o idioma. Tem facilidade para conduzir reuniões, benchmarks e discussões em inglês. Consome materiais em inglês e tem habilidade de produzir documentos e materiais no idioma. Conhecimento em plataformas que aumentam produtividade em cadências de contato. Ter experiência em venda de software para franqueadores e/ou licenciadores. MBA ou especialização em áreas correlatas (negócios, estratégia, inovação, etc.). Experiência comprovada +3 anos com desenvolvimento de negócios, parcerias ou expansão de mercado (Preferencialmente ter vendido software para licenciadores e franquadores)  Informações adicionais:  Plano de saúde com cobertura nacional sem desconto da mensalidade ou coparticipação dos Azuis. Pode se estender aos dependentes (filhos, cônjuges, inclusive de pessoas homoafetivas) conforme política interna; Plano odontológico com cobertura nacional sem o desconto da mensalidade dos Azuis. Pode se estender aos dependentes (filhos, cônjuges, inclusive de pessoas homoafetivas) conforme política interna; Benefício flexível: R$ 1.000,00 para ser investido em educação (reembolso de 70% da mensalidade), idioma (70% da mensalidade) atividades físicas e reembolso referente aos seguintes profissionais: psicólogos(as), nutricionistas, massoterapeutas e fisioterapeutas (50% do custo); Auxílio creche para Papais e Mamães com filhos entre 0 e 24 meses; Auxílio Home Office mensal à partir de R$ 150,00 a depender da localidade; Auxílio Home Office parcela única de R$ 1.500,00 para custear a estação de trabalho; Cartão Flash de vale refeição e alimentação mensal sem desconto; Zenklub: sem limite de sessões no mês para consultas com Psicólogos, Psicanalistas, Terapeutas e Coaches. As duas primeiras sessões do mês são integralmente por nossa conta, e as demais por R$ 20,00 cada; Benefício Farmácia: App Vidalink com subsídio de 75% para medicamentos com receita para todos os Azuis. Pode se estender aos dependentes (filhos, cônjuges, inclusive de pessoas homoafetivas) conforme política interna; Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas. title: Sales Executive - US Market
description:
